about: Joy M. Feinberg is an attorney providing legal services covering Family Law.

Joy Feinberg, who practices law in Chicago, Illinois, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at DePaul University College of Law. She graduated in 1977. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1977.
